h1: New Rochelle Heat Pump Rebates 2026: Con Edison
lead: What New Rochelle homeowners can really get in 2026, checked against Con Edison and NYSERDA on October 3, 2026.
cards_heading: What you can claim in New Rochelle in 2026
cards_intro:
Short answer: In New Rochelle, the main heat pump rebate is NYS Clean Heat (run by Con Edison): up to $11,000 (Disadvantaged Community, Weatherized Tier, old system removed) for a whole-home system, taken off your contractor’s bill. It is one rebate, not several that add up. Lower-income households can get much more through EmPower+, and the federal tax credits ended on December 31, 2025.

sections:
New Rochelle is a Westchester County city on Long Island Sound, served by Con Edison for electricity and gas. Plenty of homes here still burn heating oil, and oil-to-heat-pump switches are where the whole-home tier makes the most sense.

New Rochelle has a wide mix of homes, from large older houses near the Sound to post-war capes and newer downtown apartments. Bigger older homes often need a multi-zone system, which raises the price but not the rebate cap, so insulation first matters here.

Coastal flooding is a real concern in low-lying neighbourhoods near the water. Ask your installer to mount outdoor units on raised stands or brackets if you are in a flood zone.

Downtown condo owners should look at the apartment amounts in the table, and check building rules before planning a unit on a balcony or roof.

Clean Heat is the Con Edison rebate, so never add the two together. Clean Heat is capped at 70% of cost (85% in a DAC). There is no separate federal HEAR cheque: New York delivers it through EmPower+. The federal 25C/25D tax credits ended December 31, 2025.

Income-qualified? EmPower+ can cover far more than the utility rebate. Check the state DAC map too: it can raise your amount.

Con Edison has no rebate for buying a home charger. Its SmartCharge New York program pays about $400 a year on average for charging off-peak. PowerReady stopped taking new Level 2 applications on April 22, 2026.
claim_heading: What to do next in New Rochelle
claim_steps: If you are near the water, ask about raised mounting for outdoor units.
Get an energy audit on larger older homes before you size the system.
Get 2–3 quotes and ask each contractor to show the rebate tier on the quote.
faq: How much is the heat pump rebate in New Rochelle?

NYS Clean Heat (run by Con Edison) pays up to $11,000 (Disadvantaged Community, Weatherized Tier, old system removed) for a whole-home heat pump in New Rochelle, depending on home size, whether you remove the old system, and DAC status.
Does it matter if my New Rochelle home is in a flood zone?
It does not change the rebate, but it changes the install. Outdoor units should be raised above expected flood levels, which can add some cost, so ask for it in writing on the quote.
Is the federal tax credit still available for heat pumps?
No. The federal 25C and 25D credits ended for anything installed after December 31, 2025.

Lower-income owners and renters of 1-4 family homes. Low-income households can get free upgrades up to $12,000 upstate or $14,000 downstate; moderate-income households get 50% covered up to $6,000 upstate or $7,000 downstate.
